description: NSW Foundation Spatial Data Framework - Transport - Road Associated Facilities is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Customer Service. Various facilities associated with the Road dataset. The following are ‘facility points’ being a point feature class defining a facility related to transport. Bus Interchange: a connection or terminal point for long distance bus travellers or other major transport interchange. Parking Area: an area set aside for the parking of motor vehicles. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Customer Service. Its tags are Geospatial, NSW Spatial Data Framework, Road Associated Facilities, Spatial Services, Transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
